_provenance.method: Captured via GlitchTip's own apps.alerts.webhooks.send_issue_as_webhook (asdict(WebhookPayload)) against a representative in-memory Issue, by monkeypatching send_webhook to intercept the exact outgoing JSON. Read-only: no DB rows created. This is byte-identical to what GlitchTip POSTs to a 'webhook' recipient on a new-issue alert.
_provenance.note_title_link_loopback: title_link uses http://localhost:8000 because GLITCHTIP_DOMAIN is set to the loopback host on the live GlitchTip app — this is the REAL value emitted today; the parser only requires url to be present.
